modules.title: Introduction to The Nigerian Civil War
modules.html:
The causes, course, effects and reconciliation after the 1967-1970 civil war. This section covers introduction to the nigerian civil war.

Key points

  • The Nigerian Civil War (1967–1970) was triggered by _____. — the secession of the Eastern Region as 'Biafra'.
  • The Nigerian Civil War (1967-1970) began with the secession of the _____ Region. — Eastern.
  • The Nigerian Civil War lasted for: — 30 months.
  • The Nigerian Civil War ended in: — 1970.
  • The Nigerian Civil War (Biafran War) lasted from... — 1967-1970.

Worked examples

Q: The Nigerian Civil War (1967–1970) was triggered by _____.
A: the secession of the Eastern Region as 'Biafra' — General Odumegwu Ojukwu declared the Republic of Biafra in May 1967 following massacres of Igbos in the North and political instability.

Q: The Nigerian Civil War (1967-1970) began with the secession of the _____ Region.
A: Eastern — The Eastern Region, led by Lt. Col. Odumegwu Ojukwu, declared itself the Republic of Biafra.

examples.q: The Nigerian Civil War (1967–1970) was triggered by _____.
examples.a: the secession of the Eastern Region as 'Biafra'

examples.q: The Nigerian Civil War (1967-1970) began with the secession of the _____ Region.

quiz.q: The policy of 'No Victor, No Vanquished' was announced at the end of the Civil War by _____.
quiz.solution: General Gowon used this policy to promote national reconciliation and reintegration after the war.

quiz.q: The civil war ended with the policy of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: No Victor, No Vanquished.

quiz.q: The Civil War ended in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 1970.

quiz.q: The Head of State who led Nigeria through the Civil War was...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Yakubu Gowon.

quiz.q: Who led the Biafran side during the Civil War?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu.

quiz.q: The primary cause of the 19th-century 'Yoruba Civil Wars' was the _____.
quiz.solution: The collapse of the central Oyo authority led to power struggles between city-states like Ibadan, Ijaye, and Abeokuta.

quiz.q: Biafra leader during the war:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Ojukwu.

quiz.q: The Oyo Empire collapsed due to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: The Fulani Jihad & Internal crisis.

quiz.q: Who moved the federal capital from Lagos to Abuja?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Murtala Muhammed.

quiz.q: The OAU (now AU) was formed in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 1963.

quiz.q: The head of the Oyo Mesi was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Bashorun.

quiz.q: The amalgamation of the Northern and Southern Protectorates occurred in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 1914.

quiz.q: The Kano Riot of 1953 was caused by:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Motion for independence.

quiz.q: Nana of Itsekiri was a:

quiz.q: JAMB was established in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 1978.

quiz.q: Benin Kingdom is famous for:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Bronze casting.

quiz.q: Lagos was annexed in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 1861.

quiz.q: ECOWAS founded in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 1975.

quiz.q: Apartheid was in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: South Africa.

quiz.q: The title of the ruler of the Kanem-Borno Empire was...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mai.

quiz.q: Which of the following was a major cause of the fall of the Songhai Empire?

quiz.q: Lagos was annexed by the British in:

quiz.q: The fall of the Oyo Empire was caused partly by the rebellion of:
